cords.note: The twisted ends of the main cord and the first cord are linked together. Cord 1 is shorter than the other pendants and bound with thread at its end.

Subsidiaries (s1s1) attached to the first subsidiary (s1) on pendants 2, 24, 135, 157, 179, and 201 are attached in a non-standard way. They are looped around both the pendant and the subsidiary (s1) to which they are connected.
